title: Pulse
tagline: Four lanes, three tracks, no forgiveness.
description: A rhythm game with its own music. Three tracks were written for it — an arpeggio-driven chase, a slower one in the rain, and something faster than either — and the charts were cut from the same notes you hear, so what falls down the lane is exactly what is playing. Hit early or late and it will tell you which. Your best score and accuracy are kept for each track.
author: HexCave
controls: D F J K, or the arrow keys
howToPlay: Pick a track from the list. There is a short count-in before the first note.
Notes fall down four lanes. Hit them as they cross the line at the bottom with D, F, J and K — the arrow keys work too.
Land within a hair of the line for a Perfect; a little early or late is a Good, and it will tell you which way you were off.
Missing a note breaks your combo, and the combo is what multiplies your score.
Accuracy is shown live in the corner, so you can tell a sloppy full clear from a clean one.
Press escape at any point to go back and pick another track.
goal: Hit every note. Score and accuracy are kept separately for each of the three tracks.
